items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I wrote it with a guy in Honolulu there, Andy Cummings.

ctx.x: One Sunday out in Nashville. He and I wrote several little things together then. I left the -- he left the band. I started writing a few little things on my own, and I -- the first thing I wrote when he left was "What's you know, Joe", that little tune. I used to like to write little catchy phrases like that, you know. I did another song for Billie Holiday just before she died but -- and she liked it

but she wasn't in no shape to sing it then. And I've never done anything with the tune since. I wrote it with a guy in Honolulu there, Andy Cummings. But maybe later on I'll try to do something. It's called "Riff-raff", you know. Cute little tune but we never did -- she liked it but she was in no shape then when I last saw her.
But I used to like to write. I did a lot of composition.
